correction.contract: src/composition/lifecycle.ts — OwnedResource.close is now () => void | Promise<void>; the disposal loop AWAITS each resource in the recorded order, so a synchronous resource is unchanged and an asynchronous one is truly awaited
correction.readerResource: src/composition/execution_association.ts — the dshSessionReader owned resource returns readerHandle.close() (the promise) instead of voiding it
correction.noNewManager: no separate resource manager was introduced; the change is the smallest extension of the existing contract

evidence.observed: the close signature is void | Promise<void>, the loop awaits resource.close(), and the reader resource returns the promise
the existing disposal-order suite still passes, with the ordering (tools reverse, monitor stop, controller, store, ownedResources, effects) unchanged

expectedInvariant: await installed.dispose() must actually wait for the mounted Reader's cleanup; the existing synchronous-resource behavior must be preserved
